name: processtask_step_rel
label: Table of Connections Between Steps of Work Orders
description: The table linking workflow steps for use in queries related to process associations and reporting scenarios.

fields.name: processtask_id
fields.description: Work order ID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: from_process_step_uuid
fields.description: Source step UUID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: to_process_step_uuid
fields.description: The target step UUID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: from_processtask_step_id
fields.description: Source step ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: to_processtask_step_id
fields.description: Target step ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: is_hit
fields.description: 0: No flow transition was triggered; -1: A flow transition was triggered, but its conditions were not met; 1: A flow transition was triggered and its conditions were met.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the from_processtask_step_id, to_processtask_step_id fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_from_process_step_uuid
indexes.description: Standard index covering the from_process_step_uuid field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_process_task_uuid
indexes.description: Standard index covering the processtask_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_to_process_step_uuid
indexes.description: Standard index covering the to_process_step_uuid field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_to_processtask_step_uuid
indexes.description: Standard index covering the to_processtask_step_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
